$comment: The product map. `pnpm dashboard` reads this file, checks every part against GitHub issues and the code on origin/main (and on the named branch), and writes docs/dashboard/index.html. Edit features here, not in the HTML. A part's status is computed: its `paths` all on main = live (`kind: preview` = live preview); on `branch` only = built, not merged; some paths on main = in progress; none = to build (or proposal when the feature has `proposal: true`). An open issue on a live part shows as live with follow-ups. `scope: later` parts are shown but do not count toward the feature's status. `status` on a part overrides the computed one (say why in `note`). Paths ending in / match a folder.

product.name: LifeGuessr
product.tagline: A forward-looking budget planner for US adults aged 25–45, with a daily guessing game as the marketing engine.
product.pitch: Money apps forecast your accounts. We forecast your decisions, and rank which one to make next.
product.thesis: Nobody can feel what their life costs, or where small choices lead. The game proves it in a minute. The app fixes it.
